definitions.explanation: To come together with someone, either by arrangement or by chance. Used when meeting people face-to-face.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}に{会|あ}いました。
examples.notes: Use に for the person you meet

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}{会|あ}いましょう。
{久|ひさ}しぶりに{会|あ}えてうれしいです。
examples.english: I'm happy to see you after such a long time.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No transitive pair. Pattern: Xに{会|あ}う (meet X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing or habitual action. {会|あ}っている = 'is meeting' or 'have been meeting (regularly).'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{友達|ともだち}に{会|あ}う (meet a friend)
・{久|ひさ}しぶりに{会|あ}う (meet after a long time)
・{初|はじ}めて{会|あ}う (meet for the first time)
・{会|あ}いたい (want to meet/see someone)

IMPORTANT: Takes に, not を. Don't confuse with {合|あ}う (to match/fit) which uses different kanji.
